main_text.l: Aristoteles vero cum frequenter eorum sententiis
suam sapientiam illustrarit, eo praesertim caeteris pra-
estitit, quia vocibus propriis, congruente methodo,
ordineque aptissimo disciplinas principales absolvit,
& edidit: neque ob id aditum ignavis ad eas patefe-
cit, cum ea usus fit orationis brevitate, & explican-
di arte, ut soli ingenio perspicaci praediti, nec qui-
dem sine cura & labore, latentem ejus sententiam
valeant elicere.
Frequenter Platonis, Vetustiorum-
que sententias infectatur, & turbat, nonnunquam

gis, quo fama fuerunt celebriores, & tunc lites facile

page.notes: The red marks at the right edge and near the middle left are stains, not text, and are left out. The printed "cap, 1 2." is transcribed as printed, with the comma and the space between the digits.
